accessions: GSE226005 (RNA-seq SubSeries of GSE226008; GEO Series_pubmed_id 40388671)
primary_estimand: Exercise estimand of the paper: effect of 2-month treadmill running vs sedentary on gene expression in gastrocnemius muscle of 11-month-old (13-month at sacrifice) female C57BL/6 mice, measured by snRNA-seq (n = 2 mice per group), per cell type and globally (S2.7.p1, FIG7, S5.2.p1, S5.15.p1).
planned_contrasts: Running vs Sedentary, mouse gastrocnemius snRNA-seq, per cell type (19 cell types) and global; Seurat FindMarkers Wilcoxon (S5.15.p1; DEG counts only in Figure S30B, not in text)
Non-exercise bulk RNA-seq contrasts in IMR90 human fibroblasts (S2.1-S2.3, FIG2): Senescent vs Young, Hypoxia vs Normoxia, 2-DG+Hypoxia vs Hypoxia control (S5.12.p1)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S5.15.p1 (running vs sedentary per cell type: |log2FC| > 0.25 and adjusted P < 0.05; global: |log2FC| > 0.15 and adjusted P < 0.05)

paper_method: Exercise: Seurat 4.1.1 FindMarkers Wilcoxon rank-sum on snRNA-seq nuclei (S5.14.p1, S5.15.p1). Bulk IMR90 RNA-seq: featureCounts + DESeq2 1.34.0, |log2FC| > 1 or 0.58 and padj < 0.05 (S5.12.p1).
sample_inclusion: Exercise arm: sedentary vs running mice, n = 2 per group for snRNA-seq (FIG7 H). Not part of GSE226005.
paper_results: Adipocytes had the most running DEGs (Figure S30B); Ldha up after running (FIG7 J-L); DNA repair and proteostasis pathways up (S2.8.p1).
